title: IT INTERFERS WITH THE STEAMER BUTTON
text: IT INTERFERS WITH THE STEAMER BUTTON. It is lightweight and deep enough to steam entire heads of broccoli or cauliflower, fill with potatos, carrots & onions to go with my pot roast or add cabbage to it to go with my corned beef! But upon closing the lid the basket wouldn't let the steamer button close!

product_metadata.title: Stainless Steel Steamer Basket with handle for Instant Pot Accessories 6qt 8qt Pressure Cooker, Made by Kaviatek
